title: Scorpio, someone wants the real you
old_caption:
Scorpio, hood all the way up again?
Guarded isn't the same as safe. Let one person all the way in.

title: Sagittarius, honesty needs a soft landing
old_caption:
Sagittarius, you said it. Out loud. Like that.
Honesty is a gift when it has a soft landing.

title: Capricorn, put the bags down
old_caption:
Capricorn, whose bags are you carrying today?
You don't carry everyone. Asking for help is strong.

title: Aquarius, everything nobody says out loud
old_caption:
Aquarius, stay to number five. It's the one.
You're not too weird to love, and you're allowed to need people.

title: Pisces, you're going to cry at 5
old_caption:
Pisces, bet you cry at number five.
Your feelings are information, and you deserve the love you give.

title: Table for one, and loving it
old_caption:
The host said "just one?" like it was a problem. Aries heard "the whole booth is yours."
Dessert first, obviously. Who else orders like this?

title: Slept diagonal, woke up thriving
old_caption: Four pillows, zero blanket thieves, one Taurus sleeping corner to corner. Tell us your sign sleeps diagonal too.

title: Went to the concert solo
old_caption: Gemini turned to say "did you SEE that" and remembered they came alone. So they sang both parts of the duet instead. Have you ever gone to a show solo?

title: Cooked for one, made enough for twelve
old_caption: Cancer tried to cook for one person and accidentally fed every day of the next two weeks. Labelled, of course. Who in your life cooks like this?

title: Bought myself the flowers
old_caption: To: Leo. From: Leo. With love. The photo shoot that followed was not optional. When did you last buy yourself something nice?
